title: Video by prouddad2015
description:
🎾 WEEK 1 RECAP. The comeback is officially underway. 💪

One week ago, I started a journey to lose 155 lbs and find my way back to the tennis court.

After playing Division I and professional tennis, spending 25 years in the corporate world left me far from the athlete I once was. But the goal is bigger than losing weight. It’s about rebuilding discipline, reclaiming my health, and getting back to doing what I love.

✅ 5 lbs down
✅ New routines established
✅ Workouts underway
✅ One step closer to the court

The hardest part wasn’t the workouts or changing my habits. It was deciding to start—and showing up again the next day.

I’m doing this for myself, for my family, and for the chance to share my love of tennis with my kids for years to come.

155 lbs to lose. One week down. A lifetime of tennis to get back to. ❤️🎾

This is just the beginning. Follow along for the journey, the setbacks, the victories, and everything tennis along the way.

#tennis #weightloss #weightlossmotivation #weightlossjourney #weightlosstransformation
